changes: PowerPoint replaces the processed month/year in every visible slide paragraph, including split text runs such as 'J' + 'unio 2025'.
Chart titles use the processed month/year.
The extractor reuses an already-open reservation board between consecutive monthly extractions instead of invoking the board icon again.
The extractor waits briefly for the final MatchPoint postback to stabilize before returning completion.
Session detection accepts an already-open reservation board during transient ASP.NET postbacks.
live_matchpoint_note: The consecutive-month race-condition fix was unit-tested and targets the observed state transition, but a live MatchPoint session is not available in this environment, so the real website timing must be confirmed on the user's Windows installation.
